title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.36057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). translated_title: Mirror-Score：经过校准的仅推理评分方法揭示D-肽设计中序列兼容性排序的局限性
translated_abstract: D-肽兼具抗蛋白酶水解性与高靶标特异性，但其结合剂的计算设计仍不成熟。Mirror-Peptidizer提出了一种计算机镜像筛选流程，利用靶标镜像反射、主链生成与ProteinMPNN序列设计，但其原始的ProteinMPNN负对数似然（NLL）排序并未经过实测亲和力的验证，且9个受测MDM2设计中仅有4个表现出可检测的结合。我们提出Mirror-Score，一个面向异手性D-肽/L-蛋白复合物的、经过校准的仅推理评分框架，并构建了一个公开基准数据集，涵盖四个靶标家族的31个晶体复合物，其中18个具有文献验证的亲和力数据。研究表明，原始ProteinMPNN NLL并非有效的亲和力排序指标：其与亲和力的合并Spearman相关系数仅为0.19，且相关性在MDM2/CHIP（+0.62）与gp41（-0.70）之间发生反转。因此，我们进一步评估了Boltz-2镜像空间共折叠置信度（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: Mirror-Score建立了首个针对异手性D-肽/L-蛋白复合物的校准、仅推理评分基准，证明ProteinMPNN的NLL不能可靠地排序结合亲和力（合并Spearman相关性仅0.19且在不同靶标间正负反转），并引入Boltz-2镜像空间共折叠置信度作为替代评分方案。
en_tdlr: Mirror-Score introduces a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework and a public benchmark of 31 heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, demonstrating that raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker (pooled Spearman correlation of 0.19 with sign reversal across targets) and exploring Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence as an alternative.
